comparison.objective: Remove capped needles from three Luer-lock syringes and discard them safely; unlike selective screen separation.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual barrel stabilization, cap rotation, axial withdrawal, and sharps placement—not load-sharing and orientation-dependent sifting.
comparison.success_condition: Needles unscrewed, still capped, released in sharps container; exposed needle is a whole-trial failure. Numeric thresholds are specified.
comparison.reason: Tests safe threaded disassembly of attached parts, not selective passage of loose bodies through apertures.
